fussball-live: Live scores, matchdays and tables for the Bundesliga, Champions League, English, Scottish and Spanish leagues and cups, the World Cup and more. Pick your club for its crest and colours.
american-football-live: Live scores, weeks and standings for the NFL, College Football (Top 25 and major conferences), UFL and CFL. Can pop up on a touchdown.
biathlon-live: Results with shooting, live standings during a race, schedule and World Cup standings from the IBU. Highlights the athletes of your nation.
world-map-live: A calm world map with the day-night line and live aircraft, ships, lightning strikes and the ISS. Whole world or a region.
network-overview: Your home network as a living map: devices online, internet traffic, ads blocked by your Pi-holes and the state of your Unraid server, with a short note on what stands out today. Stays in your home network.
travel-map: An old-globe style world map with push pins where your photos were taken, from a playlist, the media library, a NAS folder or Immich. Shows a photo at its pin now and then.
phone-photos: Show the photo or video you are looking at on your iPhone or Android phone on the frame right away: from the share menu (also WhatsApp) or the frame's phone page. Videos play with sound. Phones pair once with a code shown on the frame. Afterwards your playlist carries on.
youtube-cast: Cast YouTube videos from your phone to the frame like to a TV: tap the cast button in the YouTube app and pick the frame, or send a link. Afterwards your playlist carries on.
ticker-wall: Turns the frame into a news-channel and trading-floor wall: news feeds, stock prices, crypto, currencies, world clocks, weather and earthquakes scrolling at once, with a topic radar, breaking-news detection and a market mood gauge. Optional alerts for keywords, price rules or strong earthquakes. Stock prices need a free Finnhub key.
growing-up: Watch your children (or anyone) grow up: picks the best face per month, quarter or year from your Immich server and plays them as a time-lapse, contact sheet, then and now, or siblings side by side at the same age. Can congratulate on birthdays.
photo-mosaic: One of your photos rebuilt from hundreds of your own photos as small tiles. The camera glides into a single tile, which turns into the real photo with date and place. Photos from a playlist, the media library or Immich.
on-this-day: Your photos of this day in earlier years as a journey through time, each with the weather back then at that place and the weather today. Ends with a summary of all years. Photos from a playlist, the media library or Immich.
color-calendar: Your year as a calendar of colours: every day becomes a cell in the colour of that day's photos, as months, weeks, rings or stripes. Photos from a playlist, the media library or Immich.
halloween-scare: A demo of reacting to Home Assistant triggers, with Halloween as the example: when a motion sensor or the doorbell goes off, a jump scare comes over the playlist (haunted portrait, ghost in the current photo, TV static or a monster), with sounds and a gentle version for children.
magic-frame: Inspired by MagicMirror²: place modules such as clock, weather, calendar, news or Home Assistant around the screen. More modules below.
playlist-button: A GPIO button opens an overlay menu to switch playlists.
webpage-button: A GPIO button opens one or more web pages full screen over the slideshow (YouTube links play as video) and closes them again.
jellyfin-now-playing: Shows the cover of what a chosen Jellyfin user is watching or listening to right now.
immich: Photos from your own Immich server in the slideshow, with DynaFrame's own display time and transitions: albums or all photos, narrowed down by stars, favourites, people or a search, random or by date. The photos stay on the server; only the next few are kept on the frame.
settings-backup: Saves the settings of all your plugins and scenes to one file and puts them back, on this frame or another one. Missing stores and packs are installed automatically. With a password the file is encrypted and also carries API keys and passwords. Every restore can be undone.
web-login: Puts a login in front of the frame's web page (password, single sign-on with your own OIDC provider, or both, optionally over HTTPS) and closes the ports that lead past it, except for devices you trust such as Home Assistant or apps with an API key. Never expose the frame to the internet.
playlist-music: Plays music while certain playlists run, each with its own music: internet radio, Jellyfin, a folder, Spotify Connect or Music Assistant, on the frame or another speaker. Fades in and out and pauses for videos.
magic-mirror-module-homeassistant: Values of any entities, house status (open windows, unlocked locks, alarms, low batteries), climate per room, who is home and bin collection. Needs Dynaframe's Magic Mirror 0.7.0 or newer
magic-mirror-module-wifi: Network name, password and a QR code guests can scan
magic-mirror-module-webuntis: Next school days with substitutions, cancellations, exams and homework
magic-mirror-module-musicassistant: What's playing on your Music Assistant server
magic-mirror-module-jellyfin: Music, movie, episode or live TV on your Jellyfin server
magic-mirror-module-pegelstand: Water level of a gauge on German federal waterways (PEGELONLINE) with trend
magic-mirror-module-traveltime: How long the drive takes right now, with traffic delay, alternative route and "Leave by" time (own Mapbox or Google key)
magic-mirror-module-fuelprices: Cheapest petrol stations near you with real-time prices and whether now is a good time to fill up (Germany, free Tankerkönig key)
magic-mirror-skin-bordcomputer: A whole new look for the Magic Mirror: rounded orange and lilac bars like the ship computers of 90s starship series, with clock, stardate and fields you fill yourself
